title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Grandparenting Guide
summary: Start grandparenting guide this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Learn the parents' house rules
2. Establish your own visit rhythm
3. Create rituals (pancakes, walks, stories)
4. Spoil moderately - then hand back
5. Offer childcare help, not takeover

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Grandparenting Guide Beginner FAQ
